feedback: Meh.

I've been using the product for about six months now and overall I think the direction is good, but I want to lay out a few things in detail. First, the redesigned navigation is genuinely a big improvement -- I can find what I need in a couple of clicks instead of digging through three levels of menus like before, and the team clearly put thought into it. Second, performance has noticeably improved on the reporting pages, which used to take upwards of ten seconds to load and now feel close to instant. That said, I've run into a recurring issue where the bulk-edit feature silently fails to save changes to about half of the selected rows when I'm editing more than fifty at once -- no error message, it just doesn't persist, and I only noticed because I double-checked. This has happened three separate times over the last two weeks and it's starting to erode my trust in the tool for anything beyond small edits. I'd really appreciate either a fix or at least a warning when this happens so I'm not silently losing work.
